title: Sharp $L^p$ estimates for the strong spherical maximal operator
summary: We prove that the strong spherical maximal operator in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is bounded on $L^p$ for $n\geq4$ and $p>(n+1)/(n-1)$. This establishes the conjecture of Hickman and Zahl in the remaining dimensions. The main ingredient is a local $L^2$ estimate for the pieces obtained by a dyadic decomposition in the normal variable. After squaring one input coordinate, we reduce this estimate to a $TT^*$ argument for diagonal quadratic phases.
